clips.title: The story
paras: Warcaller Gorlach patrols Orgrimmar, calling Horde champions to distant battlefronts. He rallies travelers and seasoned warriors to answer commands at outposts across Kalimdor and beyond.

Warcaller Gorlach walks Orgrimmar's thoroughfares, carrying the Horde's calls for expansion and defense. He gives orders among the city's people, seeking volunteers ready to test their mettle. Some he sends to the contested canopy of Ashenvale. Others he directs toward Camp Mojache in Feralas, where scouts face the wilderness. He also calls warriors to distant campaigns in the Plaguelands. As threats rise abroad, Gorlach calls on those in the capital to take up arms.
